title: kv + quant quick scratchpad (Mikaela)
content:
Daily scratchpad: kv caching + quantization experiments (feb -> mar)

Context / goal
- Trying to reduce per-token cost for our 7B family while keeping QA accuracy within 1-2% of fp16 baseline.
- Hypothesis: combine a conservative KV cache (prefix-only caching for first 8 tokens) + q4_0 quant for weights yields best latency/cost win for desktop-like LLMs.
- Also chasing a deterministic bug where streaming tokens drop after cache miss (seen on dedicated node pool A).

Quick run notes (chronological)
2026-02-20 10:45 — baseline runs - model: rwinf-7b-fp16 (baseline) - dataset: elm-qa-1k (mix of short question/answers, avg ctx 128 tokens) - scripts: run_eval.py --model rwinf-7b-fp16 --dataset elm-qa-1k --batch 4 --max-seq 256 - metrics: exact_match 78.2%, top1-acc 84.7%, median latency 68ms/token (p50), cost/unit (relative) 1.00

2026-02-22 14:10 — q4_0 static quant - model: rwinf-7b-q4_0 (weights quantized offline using quantize.py -m q4_0) - same dataset, same script except --model rwinf-7b-q4_0 - metrics: exact_match 76.4% (-1.8), top1-acc 82.9%, median latency 52ms/token, cost/unit 0.62 - note: small hallucination rate uptick for long-context examples (>200 tokens)

2026-02-25 09:30 — q4_0 + prefix KV cache (experimental)
- cache policy: prefix_len = 8, evict_policy = LRU-window(200)
- runtime flags: --kv-cache prefix --prefix-len 8 --cache-threshold 64
- metrics: exact_match 77.6% (-0.6 vs baseline), top1-acc 83.9%, median latency 39ms/token (p50), cost/unit 0.45
- observations: cold starts about 120ms extra for first request (cache warmup), but steady-state token latency excellent
- issue: on dedicated pool A, when cache entries evicted during high load we saw 502 level error + stream cut; suspected race in kv_cache::evict (file: kv_cache.cc). Logged a GitHub PR (see linked_artifacts).

Prompt sets (curated for eval and A/B)
- P0_short: single-turn Q -> short A (avg ctx 40). Use to validate immediate precision impacts.
- ex: "What does the GET /users endpoint return in our API?"
- P1_chain: 2-turn multi-step prompts that exercise KV reuse across turns (avg ctx 200).
- ex: roleplay a bug report, then ask for steps to reproduce referencing previous turn
- P2_long: long-context reading comprehension (avg ctx 600) — stress test for cache misses, attention performance

Minimal prompt templates (for reproducing locally)
- template_short = "User: {q}\nAssistant:"
- template_multi = "System: You are an assistant.\nUser: {context}\nUser: {q}\nAssistant:"

Repro steps for the streaming drop bug (notes to self)
1) Start dedicated pool A (node set: a1-a3) with runtime built from branch: fix/kv-evict-race
2) Attach load generator: 400 concurrent short sessions (P1_chain) with warmup 30s
3) Observe logs at runtime/kv_cache.* and console trace id during 502s (if seen)
- Add instrumented logging around evict() to dump key counts and backoff sleep

Quick commands used
- quantize: python tools/quantize.py --input model.pt --out model_q4_0.pt --mode q4_0 --seed 43
- run eval: python run_eval.py --model model_q4_0.pt --dataset elm-qa-1k --batch 4 --streaming true --kv-cache prefix --prefix-len 8
- curl check: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" "https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"rwinf-7b-q4_0","prompt":"User: What is..."}'

Open questions / hunches
- Why does long-context (>400 tokens) quality degrade more under q4_0 than expected? Possibility: quantization noise on attention key/query kernel; try per-channel scale (q4_1) or Symmetric quantization baseline.
- Could the eviction race be exacerbated by prefix caching logic using short-lived mmap regions? Check mmap lifecycle when pool autoscaling triggers.
- Is the cold-start penalty for KV cache acceptable for interactive apps? maybe we should pre-warm using LRU-forwarder during session bootstrap.

Next actions (prioritized)
- P0: Reproduce streaming drop reliably (no later than 2026-03-15) — add extra logging and run on pool A with debuginfo (owner: Mikaela)
- P1: Run q4_1 quant sweep for 7B family (config: per-channel scales, 8 seeds) across P0_short and P1_chain to compare EM delta (owner: Ida)
- P2: Build a tiny pre-warm shim that sends a 16-token probe to warm cache for new sessions (prototype by 2026-03-05; owner: Noah)
- P3: Add a short eval harness that records per-token confidence (logit gap) so we can measure calibration shifts with quant (owner: Mikaela)

Misc notes / ephemeral thoughts
- If q4_0 + kv prefix works reliably, we can propose a Dedicated default profile that ships with these settings for cost-conscious customers. Need product buy-in (cc: PM list).
- Keep quality monitor thresholds: EM drop > 2% triggers auto-fallback to fp16 variant for first 5 minutes.

Handy IDs and pointers
- small eval set: elm-qa-1k id: elmqa_v1
- perf benchmark harness: perf/bench_v2 (internal)
- linked PR for kv evict debug: runtime/pull/1832

Notes-to-self closing line:
- Don’t forget to rerun with mixed precision aten kernels turned off (some quant kernels assume fused aten ops) — that was an elusive diff last time.
- Next sync: quick standup with Noah + Ida on 2026-03-13 to triage P0/P1 results.
